item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence of technocratic tools in health and education, especially procurement, training, insurance-fund monitoring, and rural staffing. I did not find direct 2024 evidence that social-service staffing was dominated by patronage networks specifically. The negative evidence is mostly Party embedding and political control, not explicit patronage. I also did not find strong independent 2024 sources on social-service management quality in water or sanitation.
